executive_summary: Execution quality deteriorated: implementation shortfall changed by +27.3 bps relative to the baseline and slippage versus interval VWAP by -0.7 bps. The evidence attributes the deterioration primarily to venue degradation.

findings.statement: Parent order P-AAPL-1400 (BUY 60,000 AAPL via VWAP) executed 47,599 shares across 195 fills on 5 venues.
Implementation shortfall was +30.6 bps versus arrival 230.9750 (increased by 12.2 bps relative to the baseline's +18.4 bps).
Execution VWAP 231.6554 versus interval VWAP 231.6621: slippage -0.3 bps (baseline +0.7 bps, delta -1.0 bps).
Fill rate was 79.3% of the parent quantity with participation of 4.9% of market volume.
The parent order breached trading limits: max_position (536190.00 vs 500000.00).
Execution quality deteriorated: arrival shortfall +32.2 bps against a pre-trade estimate of +3.2 bps, a residual of +29.0 bps (+1.97 standard errors; SE 14.7 bps).
Observed participation 4.9% was within the configured VWAP ceiling of 20% (target 8.0%) - behaviour consistent with the strategy configuration and runbook.
Execution latency remained within the normal range (0.99x baseline, p99 975 us).
Realised volatility (3.30 bps/min) was in line with the baseline (1.17x).
Average quoted spread (1.84 bps) was in line with the baseline (0.99x).
Displayed liquidity was normal (97% of baseline depth).
No deployments to the execution path occurred in the hour before or during the window.
No ERROR-level log events were recorded in the window.
Venue ARCA underperformed its peers: fill rate 53% vs 86% elsewhere and slippage +3.9 bps worse than peers over 35 child orders.

Primary cause: degraded performance at a single venue (score 0.61; venue ARCA: fill-rate gap vs peers = 0.34, slippage excess = 3.9 bps; versus 5 matched peer windows the defining metric differs by -0.20 (90% CI -0.24 to -0.14)).
Market-data feed quality was normal (no stale runs or crossed quotes of note).
Implementation shortfall by component: delay -1.6 bps, spread +0.9 bps, timing +22.4 bps, opportunity +8.8 bps, fees +0.1 bps (total +30.6 bps).
Against the pre-trade estimate of +3.2 bps (fitted square-root model) the arrival shortfall +32.2 bps is a residual of +29.0 bps, +1.91 standard errors (SE 15.2 bps).
Size-weighted effective spread +3.7 bps on aggressive fills, realised spread -3.1 bps at 5 min; markouts 1 s -1.2 bps, 60 s -0.6 bps, 5 min +2.0 bps (positive = price moved our way).
Post-window gross exposure in AAPL was 110,454,651 USD (74% of the notional limit).
